src: THREE DAYS HAD PASSED SINCE THE HEAVENLY DEMON'S DEATH.
THE MARTIAL ALLIANCE STILL HADN'T FOUND HIS BODY.
ELDER HWANG, ARE YOU SURE THE RUMORS ARE TRUE?
I WOULDN'T BET MY LIFE ON IT, BUT THE EVIDENCE IS HARD TO IGNORE.
tr: TROIS JOURS S'ÉTAIENT ÉCOULÉS DEPUIS LA MORT DU DÉMON CÉLESTE.
L'ALLIANCE MARTIALE N'AVAIT TOUJOURS PAS RETROUVÉ SON CORPS.
ANCIEN HWANG, ÊTES-VOUS SÛR QUE LES RUMEURS SONT VRAIES ?
JE N'EN METTRAIS PAS MA MAIN AU FEU, MAIS LES PREUVES SONT DIFFICILES À IGNORER.

src: HEY, YOU. WHAT DO YOU THINK YOU'RE DOING IN MY SECT'S TERRITORY?
I'M JUST PASSING THROUGH. I DON'T WANT ANY TROUBLE.
PASSING THROUGH? DON'T MAKE ME LAUGH!
YOU THINK YOU CAN WALK IN HERE AND LEAVE WITHOUT PAYING?
tr: HÉ, TOI. QU'EST-CE QUE TU CROIS FAIRE SUR LE TERRITOIRE DE MA SECTE ?
JE NE FAIS QUE PASSER. JE NE VEUX PAS DE PROBLÈMES.
PASSER ? NE ME FAIS PAS RIRE !
TU CROIS QUE TU PEUX ENTRER ICI ET REPARTIR SANS PAYER ?

src: TSK. HE'S GOT SOME NERVE.
YOUNG MASTER, SHALL WE TEACH HIM A LESSON?
NO NEED. I'LL HANDLE THIS MYSELF.
...HEH. THIS ONE LOOKS LIKE HE'S BEEN THROUGH HELL AND BACK.
tr: TSS. IL A DU CULOT.
JEUNE MAÎTRE, ON LUI DONNE UNE LEÇON ?
PAS BESOIN. JE M'EN OCCUPE MOI-MÊME.
...HEH. CELUI-LÀ A L'AIR D'AVOIR TRAVERSÉ L'ENFER.

src: I HEARD THAT MANY PEOPLE WITH SEVERED MERIDIANS WERE GENIUSES.
YOU HAVE SEVERED MERIDIANS TOO, DON'T YOU?
...WHO TOLD YOU THAT?
IT'S WRITTEN ALL OVER YOUR FACE. DON'T PLAY DUMB.
HE WAS SUPPOSED TO BE WATCHING THE STORAGE.
HAHA! THAT'S WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU TRUST A DRUNK!
THIS ISN'T FUNNY! THE WHOLE WINTER'S SUPPLIES ARE GONE!
RELAX. WE'LL THINK OF SOMETHING. WE ALWAYS DO.
YOU HAVE NO IDEA WHAT YOU'VE AWAKENED.
DON'T EVEN THINK ABOUT RUNNING. YOU'RE NOT LEAVING THIS PLACE ALIVE.
TOO SLOW.
WHAT?! HOW DID HE DODGE THAT?!
THE HEAVENLY DEMON'S SWORD ART... IT CAN'T BE!
MASTER, PLEASE FORGIVE THIS UNWORTHY DISCIPLE.
I'VE BEEN SEARCHING FOR YOU FOR TEN YEARS.
GET UP. I DON'T NEED A DISCIPLE WHO KNEELS TO EVERYONE.
...THEN I'LL STAND AND FIGHT BESIDE YOU.
HMPH. SUIT YOURSELF.
I... I MADE THIS FOR YOU. IT'S NOT MUCH, BUT...
YOU DIDN'T HAVE TO GO TO ALL THAT TROUBLE!
IT WASN'T TROUBLE. I WANTED TO.
W-WHAT ARE YOU LOOKING AT?! STOP STARING!
...YOU'RE BLUSHING.
OH NO, I'M LATE AGAIN! THE TEACHER IS GOING TO KILL ME!
HEY, DID YOU DO THE HOMEWORK?
WHAT HOMEWORK?
YOU'RE SO DEAD.
DON'T TELL ME YOU FORGOT AGAIN.
[LEVEL UP!] YOU HAVE REACHED LEVEL 15.
NEW SKILL ACQUIRED: SHADOW STEP.
THE DUNGEON GATE WILL CLOSE IN TEN MINUTES.
DON'T LET YOUR GUARD DOWN. THERE ARE MORE OF THEM!
IT'S A BOSS-CLASS MONSTER... AND IT'S AWAKE.
I KNOW WHAT YOU DID LAST SUMMER.
THAT'S IMPOSSIBLE. NO ONE WAS THERE.
ARE YOU SURE ABOUT THAT?
WHO ARE YOU WORKING FOR? ANSWER ME!
IT'S TOO LATE FOR REGRETS NOW.
CHEON MU-GANG, YOU HAVE SOME NERVE SHOWING YOUR FACE HERE.
GRANDMASTER, THE PATRIARCH REQUESTS YOUR PRESENCE.
HAHAHA! SO THE RUMORS WERE TRUE AFTER ALL!
ARGH! MY ARM! MY ARM IS...!
THE FIRST FORM OF THE HEAVENLY DEMON ART: SHATTERING SKY.
THAT'S WHY I SAID...
...WE SHOULD HAVE LEFT EARLIER.
WELL, THAT'S ONE WAY TO LOOK AT IT.
HUH? WHAT DO YOU MEAN?
LET'S GO. WE DON'T HAVE MUCH TIME.
WE CAN KILL TWO BIRDS WITH ONE STONE IF WE MOVE TONIGHT.
DON'T BEAT AROUND THE BUSH. WHAT DO YOU WANT?
THE LAST STRAW WAS WHEN HE SOLD OUR HOME.
SPILL THE BEANS ALREADY! WHO SENT YOU?
IT'S NOT LIKE HIM TO RUN AWAY WITH HIS TAIL BETWEEN HIS LEGS.
THE THIEVES GOT AWAY THROUGH THE BACK GATE!
I WON'T LET YOU GET AWAY WITH THIS!
HE FINALLY CAME UP WITH A PLAN.
STOP LASHING OUT AT ME JUST BECAUSE YOU'RE SCARED.
I'LL TAKE DOWN ANYONE WHO STANDS IN MY WAY.
THE ELDERS TURNED THE WHOLE VILLAGE AGAINST HER.
I NEED TO GET THE PRINCE ON MY SIDE BEFORE THE BANQUET.
THIS CURSE WON'T GO AWAY, NO MATTER WHAT I TRY.
DON'T YOU DARE HAND HIM OVER TO THE ENVOY.
HE LOST HIS TEMPER AND RAN HIS MOUTH IN FRONT OF THE GENERAL.
I REALIZED HOW FOOLISH I HAD BEEN.
THIS ENEMY IS DEFINITELY STRONGER THAN WE THOUGHT.
NOT A CHANCE! I'M NOT GOING BACK THERE!
ACTUALLY, I WAS HOPING YOU WOULD SAY THAT.
STOP PRETENDING YOU DON'T KNOW ME.
ELDEST YOUNG MASTER, THE ELDERS ARE WAITING FOR YOU.
S-SENIOR BROTHER! PLEASE WAIT FOR ME!
THE ALLIANCE LEADER WILL ARRIVE AT DAWN.
THIS JUNIOR BEGS FOR YOUR GUIDANCE, SENIOR.
THE SECT MASTER HAS CALLED A MEETING OF ALL DISCIPLES.
B-BUT I DIDN'T DO ANYTHING!
W-WAIT! DON'T GO IN THERE!
TH-THE DEMON IS COMING!
H-HOW IS THIS POSSIBLE...?!
AAAARGH! DAMN IT, MY LEG!
YOY... YOU'RE ALL UNGRATEFUL FOOLS!
WHEN THE HELL DIO YOU LEARN THAT?!
SET IT ON ARE AND BURN EVERYTHING.
THE KING'S ARMY IS HEADING FOR THE NORTH CATE.
WHAT AREYOU DOING HERE?
YOU'RE FREAKING OUT OVER NOTHING.
DON'T GET ME WRONG, I'M NOT MAD AT YOU.
IT'S NOT LIKE I WAS WAITING FOR YOU OR ANYTHING!
HOLD ON. SOMETHING ISN'T RIGHT HERE.
I'D BETTER NOT SEE YOU NEAR HER AGAIN.
AFTER THE WAR ENDED, THE SURVIVORS SCATTERED ACROSS THE CONTINENT.
NO ONE KNEW THAT THE BOY WHO LEFT THAT NIGHT WOULD ONE DAY RETURN AS A TYRANT.
THE MORE I LEARN ABOUT THIS WORLD, THE LESS I UNDERSTAND.
IF I HAD KNOWN, I WOULD HAVE STAYED BY YOUR SIDE.
HE'S ON THE FENCE ABOUT JOINING US.
DON'T GET YOUR HOPES UP.
I'M NOT BUYING IT.
YOU'VE GOT SOME NERVE COMING HERE!
SHE HAS A BONE TO PICK WITH YOU.
tr: IL HÉSITE À NOUS REJOINDRE.
NE TE FAIS PAS D'ILLUSIONS.
JE NE SUIS PAS CONVAINCU.
TU AS DU CULOT DE VENIR ICI !
ELLE A QUELQUE CHOSE À TE REPROCHER.

src: IT SLIPPED MY MIND.
I CAN'T WRAP MY HEAD AROUND THIS.
HE'S HITTING THE ROOF.
HE PULLED A FAST ONE ON ME.
YOU'RE OUT OF YOUR MIND.
tr: J'AVAIS OUBLIÉ.
JE N'ARRIVE PAS À COMPRENDRE ÇA.
IL EST EN TRAIN DE PÉTER UN CÂBLE.
IL M'A JOUÉ UN MAUVAIS COUP.
TU ES FOU.
